title: Score32 exact partial tree factored cluster PPA scaling
hypothesis: Replacing the exact-partial tree's pair-merge exp-scale implementation with the exhaustive-equal factored exact lookup should isolate whether c16 tree depth or the old LUT encoding dominated the physical boundary. Measuring c2/c4/c8/c16 under new revision-safe identities exposes tree scaling before any finalizer or direct-link composition is blamed.

direct_comparison.primary_question: What Nangate45 area and timing boundary is exposed by standalone factored-exact score32 partial trees at 2, 4, 8, and 16 clusters under the existing first-pass 8 ns, 2500 um die, 2400 um core envelope?
include: actual attention_score32_exact_partial_tree RTL generation with factored_h33_l64_mul_exact pair merges
strict config, manifest, regeneration, and PPA-sweep guard before synthesis
hierarchical OpenROAD block sweeps at place densities 0.30 and 0.50
timing-summary extraction for each checked-in factored cluster configuration
exclude: no direct 328-bit link, NoC, or SRAM placement closure claim
no root finalizer or ordered-bank control composition
no claim that the standalone tree closes the full decoder-attention macro

remaining_abstractions: This item measures only the standalone factored exact partial reduction tree; the direct 328-bit internal links remain unclosed.
NoC transport, SRAM placement, and cluster-to-memory physical composition remain separate sources of area and timing risk.
The ordered finalizer-bank control and arithmetic remain separate components and must be measured independently before any hierarchy-level composition claim.

required_evaluations.objective: Measure Nangate45 PPA for standalone factored-exact score32 partial trees at 2, 4, 8, and 16 clusters.

expected_result.reason: This isolates tree-only scaling after the exact factorized lookup removed the old oversized ROM inference, making the c16 fan-in boundary interpretable without the flat finalized-root composition.

required_evaluations.notes: Revision-safe retry on new config/output identities only. Boundary evidence is valid here, especially for c16; direct 328-bit links, NoC/SRAM placement, and finalizer composition remain separate abstractions.
